units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 42:1">Ex. R. s. 42</cite> (ref. to <he>לצחק</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 32:6">Ex. XXXII, 6</cite>) <he>אין ש׳ האמור כאן וכ׳</he> the sport here mentioned means idolatry, debauchery, and bloodshed; <he>ומנין לש׳ שהוא וכ׳</he> and whence is it proved that ‘sport’ refers to bloodshed? (Answ. ref. to <cite ref="II Samuel 2:14">II Sam. II, 14</cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:47">Y. Peah I, 16ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>שעשה דמן … ש׳</he> he (Abner) made the blood of lads an object of sport (ref. to II Sam. l. c.).
<cite ref="Berakhot 31a:4">Ber. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>אסוֹר לאדם … ש׳ פיו וכ׳</he> man should not fill his mouth with laughter in this world (of oppression).
<cite ref="Berakhot 31a:12">Ib.</cite> <he>מתוך ש׳</he> in a mood of laughter, v. <cite ref="P01099"><he>עֲצֵבוּת</he></cite>; Y. ib. V, beg. 8ᵈ.

<cite ref="Pesachim 117a:13">Pes. 117ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 30b:4">Sabb. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>אין שכינה … מתוך ש׳ וכ׳</he> holy inspiration does not rest upon man when he is in a mood of grief, or indolence, or laughter &c.

<cite ref="Shabbat 30b:4">Ib.</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 7:3">Koh. VII, 3</cite>) <he>טוב כעס … מש׳ שמשחק וכ׳</he> better is the anger the Lord shows the righteous (by trials) in this world, than the laughter the Lord laughs with the wicked (when he makes them prosper) in this world.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:11:1">Cant. R. to VI, 11</cite> <he>מה אגוז זה ש׳ … ושעשוע וכ׳</he> as the nut is a plaything for children and an entertainment for kings, so is Israel &c.; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Eruvin 65b:2">Erub. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>אף בשַׂחֲקוֹ</he> man’s character is also recognized in his jesting.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 620:3">Yalk. Ps. 620</cite> <he>ד׳ שחוק הן</he>, v. <cite ref="U00654"><he>שְׂחִיקָה</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>שְׂחוֹקִים</he>.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:19:1">Koh. R. to X, 19</cite> (ref. to <he>לשחוק עושים לחם</he> <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:19:1">ib.</cite>) <he>לש׳ של יראות עושים לחם</he> for the revelries of idolatries they prepare bread, but the wine &c.
